items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: I said: Well, if you have patience I think I could teach you. So every night... we start to gng, gng, gng... until she learned how to sing those numbers... so we went to California.

ctx.x: Yes. Well, that connection - Mr. Conn keep in mind the band because he never heard the band, but the band - Betty Riley, an Irish girl that was raised in Mexico, and she could sing Spanish, perfect. She came to La Conga, she followed Miguelito and she was there about two or three days listening to Miguelito Valdes. She said to me: "Machito, you could teach me or show me how to sing like Miguelito - "Babalu" and "Tierra Va Tembla"? I said: Well, if you have patience I think I could teach you. So every night when…
We spent three months up there. We don't do anything in Hollywood at all. No recording - oh yeah - we recorded with Miguelito at the Music Craft. We made an album with Miguelito.
